generations.text: Tomas Dubois contacted support because the Volt Charger trips the breaker since 2026-02-15. It is a Low priority case and the status is currently New. The agent offered a refund of $420.00. The customer confirmed order ORD-25721 and asked for a replacement. The knowledge base notes that Volt Charger units are exchanged within 18 months for latch faults. A replacement unit was shipped under RMA-67944 on 2026-03-09. The tone of the thread is polite but increasingly impatient.
